metadata.description: Relational anchoring grammar, directional relations, alignments, and 3-color DFS DAG solver

relation.name: below
relation.description: Places top edge of element below bottom edge of target

relation.name: above
relation.description: Places bottom edge of element above top edge of target

relation.name: right of
relation.description: Places left edge of element right of target right edge

relation.name: left of
relation.description: Places right edge of element left of target left edge

relation.name: center of
relation.description: Centers element along horizontal and vertical axes within target

relation.name: inside
relation.description: Anchors to an inner corner or edge of a container

target.name: #elementId
target.description: References any named element in the document

target.name: previous
target.description: The immediately preceding sibling in document order

syntax_guardrail.description: NEVER put a colon after the 'offset' keyword. Offset takes a space-delimited dimension.

dag_solver_and_cycles.algorithm: 3-color Depth-First Search (DFS) topological sort: WHITE (unvisited), GRAY (in recursion stack), BLACK (resolved)

cycle_prevention.description: Cycles between mutually dependent nodes throw Cyclic layout dependency error.
cycle_prevention.resolution: Anchor landmark root elements to absolute coords '(x, y)' or 'center of canvas', and chain dependents unidirectionally.
cycle_prevention.bad: rect #boxA { at: below #boxB offset 10px; } rect #boxB { at: below #boxA offset 10px; }
